REVISED DESIGN PROPOSAL, NOT IMPLEMENTED OR APPROVED. Synthetic data only. Corrects the preservation defect in proposal-v3: the Cash-basis income, Cash-basis expenses, and Net income tiles and the Reconcile hero action already exist in apps/mobile/bookkeeping/DashboardScreen.tsx. They are not new, and they stay visible without any new query.

Layout, top to bottom (390x844 portrait, scrolls vertically; the five-tab bar is fixed):
1. App shell header: deep emerald band (#0E6B45) with the bar-mark, 'LLCBookKeepingPrivate' in white, and the existing Search action (48pt target). Shell behavior is unchanged.
2. Title block on white: business name (snapshot.business), 'Dashboard' title, and the existing helper copy 'Balances and totals come from this LLC’s persisted journal.' A period selector sits top-right with a dashed outline to mark it as PROPOSED. Its default and only pre-authorization state is 'All dates', which matches what the tiles show today.
3. Cash hero card (pale-green surface, navy type): 'Cash across bank and cash accounts', a large amount equal to the sum of balanceCents across bank and cash accounts (the existing cashBalance computation), and 'Current book balance, <todayLocalDate()>'. Two 48pt buttons: 'View accounts' navigates to Accounts, and 'Reconcile' navigates to Accounts. Both destinations are unchanged.
4. Three summary tiles in one row, each about 114pt wide, labels wrapping to two lines at 13pt or larger, no tiny columns: 'Cash-basis income' = snapshot.cashBasis.incomeCents, 'Cash-basis expenses' = snapshot.cashBasis.expenseCents, 'Net income' = snapshot.cashBasis.netIncomeCents. These come from the existing cashBasisForPeriod(database, businessId) call with no date bounds, so they cover all recorded dates. A 13pt caption below reads 'All recorded dates, from posted journal lines' so the scope is explicit. The tiles render today and need no new function.
5. 'Record an activity': three 72pt-tall action tiles. 'Record income' is the primary emerald action and calls onRecordTransaction('income'). 'Record expense' calls onRecordTransaction('expense') and 'Transfer' calls onRecordTransaction('transfer'); both use the pale-green secondary style.
6. Accounts card: title, 'Calculated from balanced journal lines', and a 'Manage' button (48pt) that navigates to Accounts. It lists every bank or cash account with its name, a 'Bank account'/'Cash account' label, and its journal-derived balance. When there are no accounts it shows the existing empty state: 'No bank or cash accounts yet' / 'Add an account to record income, expenses, or an opening balance.' with a 'Create an account' button that navigates to Accounts.
7. Below the fold, rendered order unchanged, indicated in the proposal by the scroll pill 'Scroll for activity, members, reminders, reports':
   a. Recent activity card: 'Posted transactions and opening balances', an 'All transactions' button that navigates to Transactions, and the first 5 transactions as TransactionSummaryRow (description, date, category, account, role with 'Opening balance' for opening-balance kind, amount). Empty state: 'No activity recorded' with a 'Record income' action.
   b. Members card: helper 'Ownership interests are shown separately from capital activity.', a 'Manage members' button that navigates to Members, and a MemberSummaryCard per member showing ownership percent (basis-points formatting) and bookCapitalActivityCents. Ownership is not shown as an allocation.
   c. Reminders card: 'Local notes only; reminders do not post journal entries.', a 'Manage' button that navigates to Settings, up to 4 open reminders with due date and Overdue/Upcoming status, and the empty state 'No open reminders'.
   d. Reports card: 'Open a dated cash-basis or book-basis report from persisted records.' with a 'View reports' button that navigates to Reports.
8. Tab bar: Dashboard (active, pale-green pill), Transactions, Members, Reports, More.

Visual tokens: white #FFFFFF base; emerald #0E6B45 for the header and primary action; navy #14284B / #2E4566 for type; pale green #E8F4EC / #EEF7F1 surfaces with #CFE5D6 / #D3E6DA borders; muted #4A5873 helper text. All text is 13pt or larger. Every interactive control is 48pt or taller. Money uses the existing Money formatter and fixed-precision cents; there is no floating-point arithmetic.

Period selector (NEW, requires authorization): when authorized, choosing a fiscal year or period would scope the three tiles to that range through a new dashboard wiring of the existing cashBasisForPeriod(from, through) path, and the caption would show the period and basis. Database icon with an alert mark, title 'Local books are unavailable', an error detail card with the existing loadError text, and a mist note 'Your existing encrypted files have not been replaced.' Nothing can overwrite data without the explicit restore confirmation in BOOT-03. Privacy note: books are stored on this device, with no recovery server or key escrow. States: error, retrying, retry failed.
